ja: 水戸岡鋭治氏オリジナルデザインのパッケージで登場。
バリエーションパーツとして中間車の屋根が4枚入り、パーツの差替えで初期車・後期車の再現が可能。
※側面パーツは後期車のみ封入しています。（初期車を再現する際は後期車用側面パーツで代用します）
トレインマークが3種付属！
en: Appears in a package originally designed by Eiji Mitooka.
Four intermediate car roofs are included as variation parts, and it is possible to reproduce early and late cars by replacing parts.
*Side parts are included only for later models. (When reproducing an early car, use side parts for later cars instead)
Three types of train marks are included!
